blocks.text: Exhale explores color, atmosphere, and the emotional experience of looking. These are not photographs of a place so much as photographs of atmosphere—moments when water, sky, light, and fog dissolve into fields of color and tone.
The horizon provides structure, but the subject is what exists beyond description: stillness, ambiguity, distance, and feeling.
Through primarily long exposures and restraint, Exhale asks the viewer to slow down, look longer, and enter the space of the image.
